plugins.name: salesforce-development
plugins.description: Foundation layer for Salesforce platform development — 38 skills for environment validation, project scaffolding, scratch-org lifecycle, declarative metadata, Apex (author, run anonymous, test, debug), flow automation, SOQL, deploy/retrieve, manifest generation, security, reporting, and generated installed-versus-available capability discovery, plus org-context detection, a production deploy-safety gate, and a bundled Apex + SOQL language server (MCP).
